name: launch
title: Launch
description: A crisp product site for software and apps — hero, numbered features, a pricing table and, as its signature, a colour-coded release timeline that starts on the home page and proves the product is alive, one node per release.

tokens.--font-sans: all interface and body text (geometric-feeling system sans)
tokens.--font-mono: version chips, dates, code (the release-notes voice)
tokens.--text-xl: headings inside a page and the newest release
tokens.--tracking-tight: negative letter spacing for large headlines
tokens.--color-panel: plan and quote cards, the screenshot frame, chips
tokens.--color-rail: the line the release timeline hangs on
tokens.--color-accent: links, focus rings, the live dot
tokens.--color-on-primary: text placed on the primary button
tokens.--color-new: the New tag and its timeline node; also untagged releases
tokens.--color-improved: the Improved release tag and its timeline node
tokens.--color-fixed: the Fixed release tag and its timeline node
tokens.--tint-chip: how strongly tag chips and node rings are tinted with their color
tokens.--tint-hero: how strongly the screenshot frame, the recommended plan and the closing call-to-action band are tinted with the accent
tokens.--shadow-lift: the only shadow: screenshot frame and recommended plan
tokens.--page-width: maximum page width (masthead, hero, plan grid)
tokens.--card-min: narrowest a feature, plan or quote may get before the row wraps
tokens.--radius: corner rounding for buttons and code
tokens.--radius-l: corner rounding for cards and the screenshot frame
tokens.--radius-pill: rounding of chips and the What's new pill (0 makes them square)
